comparison.objective: Load a caulking gun and seal a bath joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a cartridge, operate the rod and trigger, and coordinate extrusion with tool motion.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% of the joint must receive a continuous adequate bead, and the gun must be safely released.
comparison.reason: The central ability is tool loading plus controlled material deposition. It does not test bearing-carriage transfer across a butted support interface.
